entries.name: Arien
entries.blurb: Steel-teal scale armour, a visored crest, an amethyst at the belt and a crescent blade — his slashes are torrents of water, not lightning.

entries.name: Silverarrow
entries.blurb: Copper hair in a high ponytail with teal ties, olive leathers, a ridged leather pauldron, a quiver of glowing arrows and a bronze recurve with a silver string.
